propositions: Close must require a separately attested current plan review via new gate before completion when enforce flag is enabled, without running review inside close or invalidating implementations due to file changes.

CLOSE validity profile accepts certified reviews with current registry and own material despite HEAD or per-file dependency drift, while remaining sensitive to unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility.

The gate check must be pure local (zero network/model calls), run under existing transaction lock after fresh state read and before STATUS append, and fail closed as unavailable on unexpected exceptions.

Pin drift/missing/malformed validity verdicts block only when enforce_plan_material_pins flag is true; all other verdicts (unsigned, stale-reopened, stale-regver, stale-material, incompatible-phase, malformed-phase) always block.
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and non-empty force-close bypass both completion and plan-review gates without double-lock or second critical section.

Generic pre_status_check callback must be added to txn.transition_core, invoked inside existing lock immediately before STATUS append, with failure aborting transaction without append/commit and no plan-review coupling in txn.py.
